posts.title: Learning C++ after Rust
posts.description: Nearly all of my programming experience is in the Rust programming language. And I feel that's hindered my ability to be a 'good programmer'. Rust is a difficult language to learn. And there's a reason that most people don't recommend learning it as a first language. Many of Rust's valuable features are quite complex.
